runs.name: Terex Corporation; REV Group, Inc. acquired 2026-02-02 for 0.9809 Terex shares plus $8.71 cash a REV share; four segments since
runs.box: TOO HARD (WORK) AT Q2; research pass written, closed unrun; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$51.49** (quote of 2026-10-13 through `tools/sources.py`, aggregator, flagged). Shares **114.3 million**, one class (10-Q cover 2026-07-28, `0000097216-26-000116`; issued 134.4M less treasury 20.8M = 113.6M at 2026-06-30), including the 47.9M issued to REV holders on 2026-02-02; cap **$5,885M**; net debt **$2,280M** at 2026-06-30 (debt $2,687M less cash $407M, operating leases left out). Sovereign **5.60%** (US Treasury par curve, 30-year, 10/09/2026). Filings read: 10-K FY2025 (`0000097216-26-000035`), 10-Q to 2026-06-30, proxy 2026 (`0000097216-26-000071`), 8-K of 2026-07-31 with REV's last quarter and the pro forma combination (`0000097216-26-000124`), 10-Ks FY2018 to FY2024, REV 10-Ks FY2021 to FY2025; one figure cross-checked (FY2025 operating cash $440M against the filed cash-flow statement). Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the FY2025 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7, stated in the run file. Competitors: Astec (Materials Processing), Oshkosh Access/JLG (Aerials), Federal Signal ESG (Environmental Solutions), Oshkosh Vocational (Specialty Vehicles) from their own filings; Metso, Sandvik, Dingli, Haulotte and others flagged as not SEC filers, Deere's Kleemann not separable. **Q1 IN**: Materials Processing (crushers and screens, 42% of five-year segment profit, none above half) a dealer-sold machinery maker readable from ten years of segment figures; Aerials' doubt (trade duties against Chinese makers) carried. **Q2 TOO HARD (WORK)**: MP held double-digit operating margins every year 2017 to 2025 (11.4% in the 2020 trough), 9% to 17% pre-tax on identifiable assets 2020 to 2025, above Astec's on a measure that flatters Astec; but no filing read shows a cost, price or share position against Metso, Sandvik and Kleemann, and the filer says it competes "particularly" on price; WORK because those rivals publish annual reports outside the SEC. Aerials below JLG in six of seven years (5.0% against 11.2% in 2025); ES below Federal Signal ESG in each of three years; REV below Oshkosh Vocational in each of three. Research pass steps 1 and 2 written (Metso and Sandvik segment margins FY2016 to FY2025, MP's MD&A in down years, any stated share); **closed unrun** under Part VII's rule of 2026-10-12, since no case earns the floor at the price. Q3 to Q12 not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash before interest, five-year averages, Terex $264.8M plus REV $104.8M = $369.5M after all spending, $427.5M after maintenance only; serial acquirer (net purchases $1,634M), so the organic pair is central, organic growth 2.30% a year built by the analyst from segment notes (the filer reports none); range **$46.84 to $49.35 a share all-equity** (organic pair, maintenance central) against $51.49; all-spending $37.79 to $49.35 and acquisitions deducted -$6.67 beside; best case 6.26% at the price, best single year (2025) 9.56%, both under the floor; fair **$17.66 all-equity**, $24.71 equity-only, not armed (box not OUT at Q7). The run asks for a re-look alert at the top of its range ($49.35) as for an OUT; this cycle arms none, the prompt arming only a fair price at OUT at Q7 or IN, left for the operator. Balance sheets: tangible equity about +$1.36B (2023) to about -$540M (2026-06-30) after ESG ($2,010M, 2024-10-08) and REV (provisional consideration $3,384M); debt $623M to $2,687M, nothing maturing before 2029; interest coverage 1.1x in the first half of 2026; inventory 23% of sales in 2023, its release driving 2025 cash; the 2018 fall in retained earnings from retiring 50M treasury shares. After the stop: REV shares issued at $58.99, inside the analyst's Terex-alone range of $58.49 to $63.59, recorded not judged; REV earned 5.4% pre-tax on its price in its best year; integrity facts recorded, not judged: annual EBITDA and EPS guidance (2025 EPS outlook $4.70 to $5.10 against GAAP $3.33, whether adjusted not read), an adjusted segment measure from 2026 ($456M adjusted against $105M GAAP operating profit in the half), reported ROIC at a 13.5% adjusted tax rate against 24.3% reported, pay on adjusted operating profit and adjusted ROIC, restructuring in every quarter. Contamination declared by the analyst: the session's opening commit subjects (another company's v5 run), file names in two `Test Runs/` listings (other tickers containing TX; no prior Terex file listed), the memory index; none used; the analyst also confessed running the Q7 arithmetic before writing Q2. Commits b6bf9d32, 4d40aca9, 0fcb1ad9, fe721aee. Citations: the analyst's check passed; the dispatcher's script (`fold_cite_check.py`) 62 ids, 54 distinct, all in the ledger, 13 quoted fragments, no slip, no E-id. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) Q2's parts threshold reads a five-year record that no longer describes a company that has just merged (ESG owned fifteen of sixty months, REV none; in the 2026 half ES, MP and SV each about a third); (2) the serial-acquirer pair undercounts a large late purchase while the default pair goes negative, neither valuing the business as it stands; (3) organic growth "as the filer reports it" where the filer reports none; (4) specific (e) silent on whether growth capital spending stops after year ten; (5) the brief's SEC-filer limit on rivals decided the box's cause (WORK, not NATURE); (6) no rule for which rival returns count when the best-placed rivals do not file with the SEC. Could not get: Metso and Sandvik segment results, any market-share figure, a 2025 Utilities sales figure, organic growth as the filer would report it, REV's FY2024 tax tied to the bus sale.
runs.narr: Q2 TOO HARD (WORK): the maker of crushers and screens, aerial work platforms, refuse and utility bodies and, since the REV merger of 2026-02-02, specialty vehicles, whose deciding part, Materials Processing, held double-digit margins through the cycle and beat Astec, but no filing read shows a cost, price or share edge over Metso, Sandvik and Kleemann, which publish outside the SEC, and the filer says it competes "particularly" on price; Aerials trails JLG, ES trails Federal Signal, REV trails Oshkosh. Research pass written, closed unrun: no case earns the floor. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: range $46.84 to $49.35 a share all-equity (organic pair) against $51.49; fair $17.66 all-equity ($24.71 equity-only), not armed. Tangible equity negative after ESG and REV, interest cover 1.1x in the 2026 half. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: guidance, adjusted measures featured and paid on.
